blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Generative video models are increasingly used as visual world simulators, yet their primary strength lies in rendering plausible pixels rather than reasoning about how a world should evolve. Coherent world evolution requires more than visual fidelity: when an event occurs, a model must infer its consequences for the entities in the world and then render the resulting state. For example, after a wild beast appears, the model should not only depict the wild beast, but also infer whether a nearby person should flee, take cover, or fight back based on the realized scene. Existing diffusion-based video models lack an explicit mechanism for maintaining world state and reasoning over such event-conditioned consequences, often producing visually plausible but behaviorally static or causally inconsistent outputs. To make this reasoning gap concrete and measurable, we propose a new problem, Out-of-Sight Causal Evolution, which requires a model to render an event, reason about its consequences for the evolving world state, and reveal a causally plausible outcome as the world continues to evolve, even out of sight. As a baseline reference solution, we introduce EvoWorld, a brain-renderer collaboration framework in which a vision-language model serves as the world brain: it observes generated segments, maintains an evolving account of the world, and reasons about plausible state transitions, while a segment-autoregressive video renderer realizes them visually. We further introduce EvoWorld-Data and EvoWorld-Bench for training and evaluating event realization, causal reactions, and revisit consistency. Experiments show that EvoWorld substantially improves event-conditioned causal evolution over recent models while preserving visual quality and consistency, establishing a reference point for reasoning-guided, autonomous world evolution beyond the current field of view.
blocks.zh: 基因视频模型被越来越多地用作视觉世界模拟器,然而它们的主要优点在于使像素具有合理性,而不是对世界应如何演变进行推理. 连贯的世界进化需要的不仅仅是视觉上的忠诚:当一个事件发生时,一个模型必须推断它给世界上的实体带来的后果,然后形成由此产生的状态. 例如,在野兽出现后,模型不仅应该描绘野兽,而且还应该推断附近人是否应该逃离,隐蔽,或者根据已实现的场景反击. 现有的基于传播的视频模型缺乏一种明确的机制,无法维持世界状态和对这种事件附带条件的后果进行推理,往往产生表面上看似可行的但行为静止或因果不一致的产出。 为了使这一推理差距具体和可以衡量,我们提出了一个新的问题,即“视外因子演化”,它要求有一个模型来使一个事件发生,说明它对不断演变的世界状态的后果,并揭示出一个因果上可能的结果,因为世界在继续演化,甚至无法想象。 作为基线参考解决方案,我们引入了“EvoWorld”, 一个大脑增强者协作框架,其中视觉语言模型作为世界大脑: 它观测生成的片段, 维持一个不断演变的世界的叙述, 以及合理的状态过渡的原因, 而一个片段自动反转的视频渲染器可以视觉地意识到它们。 我们进一步介绍EvoWorld-Data和EvoWorld-Bench,用于培训和评估事件实现情况,因果反应,重新审视一致性. 实验表明,EvoWorld在保持视觉质量和一致性的同时,大大改进了与近期模型相比的以事件为条件的因果演化,为推理指导,自主的世界演化建立了超越当前视野的参考点.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Building models that can simulate evolving environments has become an important research direction in generative AI. By learning world dynamics, a world model uses observed history and input actions to predict plausible future states ( Team et al., 2026b ; Gao et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ; Assran et al., 2025 ) . Such predictive representations have enabled progress in decision making and autonomous driving ( Feng et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ; Liang et al., 2025 ; Gao et al., 2024b ; Gao et al., 2024a ) , agent training and embodied intelligence ( Li et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Hafner et al., 2025 ) , and synthetic environment generation ( Bruce et al., 2024 ; Brooks et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 能够模拟进化环境的构建模型已经成为基因AI的重要研究方向. 通过学习世界动态,一个世界模型利用观测到的历史和输入行动来预测可信的未来状态(Team等,2026b;Gao等,2026;Zhang等,2026b;Assran等,2025). 这种预测性表述使决策和自主驾驶方面取得了进展(冯等,2025;周等,2025;梁等,2025;高等,2024b;高等,2024a;高等,2024a),代理培训和体现智能(李等,2025;王等,2025;哈夫纳等,2025;)和合成环境生成(布鲁斯等,2024;布鲁克斯等,2024.).

blocks.en:
Generative video models ( Wan et al., 2025 ; HaCohen et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2025c ; Wu et al., 2025 ) provide a direct approach to visual world modeling ( Team et al., 2026b ; He et al., 2025 ; Team et al., 2026a ) : their predictions are immediately observable, while text and camera controls offer intuitive interaction. Yet locally plausible frames alone do not yield a coherent long-horizon world. A model must preserve the environments it has traversed and the events that have occurred; otherwise, later states become disconnected from the history that should have produced them.
Accordingly, recent video world models have explored various mechanisms for long-horizon memory and consistency, including recurrent state-space memory ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) , memory retrieval or dynamic frame eviction ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) , and geometry-grounded spatial memory (e.g., 3D point clouds) ( Wu et al., 2026 ; Team et al., 2026a ; Ma et al., 2026a ) .
blocks.zh:
基因视频模型(Wan等,2025;HaCohen等,2026;Yang等,2025c;Wu等,2025)为视觉世界建模提供了直接方法(Team等,2026b; He等, 2025; Team等, 2026a) :他们的预测立即被观察到,而文本和相机控制则提供直观的相互作用. 然而,仅靠当地可行的框架并不能形成一个连贯的长距离世界。 一个模型必须保存它所经历的环境和已经发生的事件;否则,后来的国家就会脱离本来应该产生它们的历史。
因此,近代影视世界模式探索了多种长相记忆和一致性机制,包括经常的状态-空间记忆(Zhu等,2026年),记忆取回或动态帧驱逐(Yu等,2025年;Yang等,2026年)和几何定位空间记忆(如3D点云)(Wu等,2026年;Team等,2026年a;Ma等,2026年a).

blocks.en: Most existing approaches nevertheless focus on preserving or retrieving previously observed visual states. Such persistence is necessary but insufficient: coherent world evolution also requires reasoning about how entities should change as new events unfold. This highlights a key limitation of current video models: they primarily rely on diffusion-based generation to render visual observations, without an explicit mechanism for reasoning over world states and event consequences. For example, when a monster appears, a model should not only render the monster faithfully, but also infer whether a nearby character should flee, seek cover, or fight back according to the realized world state. The challenge becomes especially pronounced when the affected subject is outside the current field of view: its resulting state cannot be determined simply by restoring its last observed appearance, but must also incorporate changes inferred from the intervening event. To make this reasoning gap concrete and measurable, we formulate a new problem, Out-of-Sight Causal Evolution , which requires a model to realize an event, reason about how the event changes the relevant world state, including its consequences for an out-of-sight subject, and render the resulting state when the subject is revisited.
blocks.zh: 然而,大多数现行办法都侧重于保留或恢复先前观察到的可视状态。 这种持久性是必要的,但还不够:协调的世界演变还需要对实体应如何随着新事件的发生而改变进行推理。 这凸显出当前视频模型的一个关键局限性:它们主要依靠基于传播的生成来进行视觉观察,没有针对世界状态和事件后果的推理的明确机制. 例如,当一个怪物出现时,一个模型不仅应该使怪物忠实,而且还应该推断附近的角色是应该逃离,寻求掩护,还是应该按照已实现的世界状态来反击. 当受影响的主体处于当前视野之外时,挑战变得特别明显:其后果状态不能仅仅通过恢复其最后一次观察到的外观来确定,还必须包括从干预事件中推断出的改变。 为了使这个推理差距变得具体和可以衡量,我们提出了一个新的问题,即视外因子演化(Out-Sight-Causal Evolution),它需要一个实现一个事件的模型,说明这个事件如何改变相关的世界状态的原因,包括它对一个视外因子的后果,并在重新审视这个主题时使这个事件产生状态.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Challenges in Out-of-Sight Causal Evolution . The camera first observes a subject (a vendor and his handcart), moves away to reveal a newly requested event (a collapsing building facade), and then moves back to the original scene. Previous methods (rows 1–4) exhibit various failures. In contrast, EvoWorld (row 5) realizes the event, revisits the original subject, and renders a causally plausible reaction while preserving subject and scene consistency.
blocks.zh: 图1 外视因子进化的挑战 摄影机首先观察一个主题(一个卖家和他的手卡),然后搬走以揭示新要求的事件(一个倒塌的建筑物外观),然后搬回原地. 以前的方法(第1至4行)显示出各种失败。 相形之下,"EvoWorld"(第5行)意识到了事件,重新审视了原来的主题,在保持主题和场景一致性的同时,使一个因果上可信的反应.

blocks.en: Out-of-Sight Causal Evolution couples three challenges that existing models rarely address simultaneously: preserving subject and scene consistency across camera motion; realizing an event introduced by a mid-rollout prompt switch; and reasoning about, then rendering, a causally plausible world-state transition, revealed through the subject’s response when the camera returns. As illustrated in Fig. 1 , HY-World 1.5 ( HunyuanWorld, 2025 ) , Echo-WM ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , LingBot-World ( Team et al., 2026b ) , and SANA-WM ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) exhibit various failures: the event or reaction may be absent, the subject may follow the camera or become duplicated, appearance and background may drift, or the subject may exhibit implausible behavior. Appearance persistence, instruction following, and event-conditioned behavior must therefore be measured jointly. Therefore, we introduce EvoWorld-Data, a controlled generative dataset of around 12k long videos ( ≥ 10 \geq 10 seconds). The training set spans 19 event families and 65 fine-grained event types, 16 scene families and 63 fine-grained scene types, and 14 reaction types across photorealistic and game-world domains. Segment-level prompts and temporal annotations provide direct supervision for event realization, long-range visual continuity, and behavioral change.
blocks.zh: Out-Sight-Causal Evolution 配对了现有模型很少同时处理的三项挑战:在相机运动中保持主题和场景的一致性;实现由中间启动的即时开关引入的事件;以及在相机返回时通过主题的反应揭示出一个因果上可信的世界状态转变的推理。 如图1所显示,HY-World 1.5(HunyuanWorld,2025年),Echo-WM(Zhang等,2026年b),Ling Bot-World(Team等,2026b.),而SANA-WM(Zhu等,2026)表现出了各种失败:事件或反应可能缺席,主体可能跟随相机或被复制,外观和背景可能漂移,或者主体可能表现出不合理的行为. 因此,必须共同衡量表象的持久性、遵循的指令和有事件条件的行为。 因此,我们介绍EvoWorld-Data,这是一个由大约12克长相相片组成的受控基因数据集(~ 10\克10秒). 培训范围包括19个事件家庭、65个精细事件类型、16个场景家庭和63个精细场景类型,以及14个跨光现实和游戏世界领域的反应类型。 分节级提示和时间说明为事件实现,远程视觉连续性,行为变化提供直接监督.

blocks.en:
As a reference solution, we develop EvoWorld, a reasoning-and-retrieval-augmented framework that separates world-state reasoning from visual rendering. A VLM serves as a world brain that continuously perceives and records the evolving world state, while the renderer generates the next segment based on the reasoning from the world brain .
We train the renderer on EvoWorld-Data with Identity-Anchored Attention and a two-stage strategy that first learns reactive rendering from clean data and then reduces exposure bias through online autoregressive rollout training.
We further introduce EvoWorld-Bench, which evaluates whether the camera revisits the original region, the switched prompt realizes the requested event, the subject responds plausibly, and the subject and background remain consistent. These coupled capabilities are not captured by existing video benchmarks such as VBench ( Huang et al., 2024 ) , which primarily emphasize perceptual quality and short-range temporal behavior.
blocks.zh:
作为参考解决方案,我们开发出"EvoWorld"(EvoWorld),这个推理和检索强化的框架将世界-状态推理与视觉渲染区分开来. VLM是一个持续感知和记录不断演变的世界状态的世界大脑,而渲染器则根据来自世界大脑的推理产生下一部分.
我们在EvoWorld-Data上对制作者进行身份-安克雷德(EvoWorld-Data)的训练,并采用两阶段战略,首先从干净的数据中学习反应性渲染,然后通过在线自相递入式推广培训来减少曝光偏差.
我们进一步引入了EvoWorld-Bench,它评价相机是否重新审视了原来的区域,切换的即时意识到了所要求的事件,主题有合理的反应,主题和背景仍然一致. 现有的视频基准,如V Bench(Huang等,2024年),没有抓住这些相接能力,这些基准主要强调知觉质量和短距离时间行为.

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold: (i) We formulate Out-of-Sight Causal Evolution , an event-conditioned world-evolution problem that requires revisit consistency, mid-rollout event realization, and causal reactive evolution. (ii) We introduce EvoWorld, a world-brain–renderer collaboration framework that separates world-state reasoning from visual rendering to continuously perceive, reason about, and render out-of-sight world dynamics. (iii) We propose EvoWorld-Data, which contains around 12k videos spanning diverse scenes, events, and reactions, and introduce EvoWorld-Bench to measure the Out-of-Sight Causal Evolution capability. We hope this work holds the potential to advance the research of out-of-sight dynamics and causal evolution in video world modeling.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献有三: (一)我们提出"外视"(Out-Sight-Causal Evolution),这是一个事件性的世界进化问题,需要重新审视一致性,中期推出事件实现,以及因果反应演化. (二) 我们引入了EvoWorld, 即一个世界大脑-增强协作框架, 将世界状态推理与视觉渲染区分开来, 以持续感知, 理性, 并渲染世界外观动态。 (三)我们提议EvoWorld-Data, 包含大约12k个视频, 涵盖各种场景、事件和反应, 我们希望这项工作有潜力推进影视世界建模中视外动态和因果演变的研究.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Video world models & autoregressive video generation. Generative video backbones ( Wan et al., 2025 ; HaCohen et al., 2026 ; MiniMax, 2026 ) provide the visual synthesis foundation for interactive world simulation, including recent models and systems such as XGEN ( Cai et al., 2026 ) , Zing-0.5 ( Chen et al., 2026b ) , and WorldPlay2 ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) . LingBot-World ( Team et al., 2026b ) and LingBot-World-v2 ( Gao et al., 2026 ) support long-horizon, real-time interaction, with the latter combining bidirectional and autoregressive attention. Echo-WM ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) targets open and enterable omnimodal world simulation, while Alaya-EVOKE ( Yin et al., 2026 ) combines persistent world-state memory, mid-rollout reprompting, and few-step generation. Segment-autoregressive methods preserve full attention within each generated segment to reduce the quality degradation associated with fully causal adaptation. YUME-1.5 ( Mao et al., 2026 ) combines long-context generation with bidirectional-attention distillation. Matrix-Game 3.0 ( Wang et al., 2026 ) uses memory-augmented multi-segment autoregressive distillation. BiWM ( Rui et al., 2026 ) provides a general recipe for adapting bidirectional video backbones into controllable segment-autoregressive world models. We build on this formulation and focus on whether the generated world continues to evolve beyond the current field of view.
blocks.zh: 视频世界模式与自相递回式视频生成. 基因视频骨干(Wan等,2025;HaCohen等,2026;MiniMax,2026)为互动世界模拟提供了视觉合成基础,包括XGEN(Cai等,2026),Zing-0.5(Chen等,2026b)等近期模型和系统,以及WorldPlay2(Zhang等,2026a). 灵灵 Bot-World(Team等,2026b)和LingBot-World-v2(Gao等,2026)支持长视,实时互动,后者结合了双向和自相递减的注意力. Echo-WM(Zhang等,2026b)以开放和可进入的可通式世界模拟为目标,而Alaya-EVOKE(Yin等,2026b)结合了持续的世界状态记忆,中回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回 部分自动递减方法在每一产生的部分中保持充分关注,以减少与充分因果适应相关的质量退化。 YUME-1.5 (Mao等, 2026年)将长文本生成与双向心蒸馏相结合. Matrix-Game 3.0 (Wang等, 2026) 使用内存加固多段自旋蒸馏. BiWM(Rui等,2026年)提供了将双向视频主干线改编为可控分段-自动回转世界模型的一般食谱. 我们以这一提法为基础,并侧重于所产生的世界是否继续超越目前的观点。

blocks.en: Out-of-sight memory and dynamics. Long-horizon consistency does not ensure that an unobserved world continues to evolve. Recent evaluations expose this limitation through camera look-away, occlusion, or illumination changes ( Ma et al., 2026b ; Lu et al., 2026 ) . ReMind ( Xu et al., 2026 ) trains a causal video generator to recover evolving states across interruptions. LiveWorld ( Duan et al., 2026 ) maintains a persistent global state by separating a static 3D environment from dynamic entities advanced by an evolution engine. Hybrid Memory ( Chen et al., 2026a ) distinguishes static-background preservation from dynamic-subject tracking across exit–reentry intervals. These works primarily examine whether an active process or motion continues through an observation gap. Our setting instead focuses on introducing an event after the subject leaves view and inferring its consequences when the subject is revisited, combining mid-rollout instruction following ( Yang et al., 2025b ) , long-range entity consistency, and reasoning over the realized visual history.
blocks.zh: 外观记忆与动态. 长视野的一致性不能确保一个无人观察的世界继续演变。 最近的评价通过相机外观、闭塞或照明变化暴露出这种局限性(Ma等人,2026年b;Lu等人,2026年)。 ReMind (Xu等, 2026年) 训练出一个因果视频生成器, 以通过中断恢复不断发展的状态. LiveWorld(Duan等,2026年)通过将静态3D环境与由进化引擎所推进的动态实体相分离,维持了持续的全球状态. Hybrid Memory(Chen等,2026a)区分了静地-后地保存与跨出-再入间隔的动态主体跟踪. 这些工作主要审查一个积极过程或运动是否通过观测差距而继续。 我们的设定则侧重于在主题离开后介绍一个事件,并推断其后果,然后重新审视该主题,将中期推出指令(Yang等人,2025年b),远程实体一致性和对已实现的视觉历史的推理结合起来。

blocks.en: 3 EvoWorld: Data and Method
blocks.zh: 3 EvoWorld:数据和方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Problem & Task Setting
blocks.zh: 3.1 问题和任务设置

blocks.en: A world evolves continuously rather than only where and when it is being observed. Its entities should therefore remain active participants in that evolution: as new events occur and environmental conditions change, they should autonomously interact with those changes and exhibit appropriate responses, including while they are outside the current field of view. Leaving the frame should not freeze an entity or remove it from the unfolding dynamics—it is out of sight, but not out of the world . We therefore formulate Out-of-Sight Causal Evolution as a task for measuring whether a video world model or generation system can maintain a coherent account of off-screen entities and the relevant world state, infer how intervening events should alter that state and affect those entities, and render causally plausible outcomes, e.g., the entities’ responses, when the scene is revisited. Here, causal evolution means that the revealed post-event state must follow plausibly from the event actually realized, rather than merely remain visually consistent with the preceding frames.
blocks.zh: 世界不断演变,而不只是在人们所看到的地方和时间。 因此,其实体应继续积极参与这种演变:随着新事件的发生和环境条件的改变,它们应自主地与这些变化互动并表现出适当的反应,包括当它们不在目前视野之外时。 离开这个框架不应该冻结一个实体, 或把它从正在发展起来的动态中移除, 因此,我们制定 " 视界外因子演化 " 计划,作为衡量视频世界模型或生成系统是否能够对屏幕外实体和相关的世界状态进行连贯的描述的一项任务,推断干预事件应如何改变这种状态并影响这些实体,并在重新审视现场时使实体的反应等因果上可能的结果。 在这里,因果演化意味着,揭示的后事件状态必须从实际实现的事件中合理遵循,而不只是在视觉上与前述框架保持一致.

具体地说,如图1所显示的,一个外视 Causal Evolution 的展开可以被抽象为至少三个语义部分(每个部分至少相当于一个快):
(1) Pinit\mathcal{P}_{\-mathrm{init}}(首字母: covers):涵盖情景和主体初始状态的部分. 条件 p i n i t s_{nit} 指定对象和场景,相机保持静态或开始远离主体.
(2) P事件\ mathcal{P}_{\-mathrm{event}}(事件):在初始状态后介绍一个事件的部分,主题因为相机视图已移出而离开了帧. P e  v e n t s- event} 介绍一个事件(例如“某事着火了”), 相机可能保持静止, 继续移动以显示事件, 或开始返回原区域。

blocks.en:
(1) Scenario design and video data generation. Existing real-world video datasets rarely contain samples that align with our experimental setting. We therefore construct a controlled generative dataset. The curated data aims to make event-conditioned world-state evolution observable, with the event-to-reaction causal chain separately auditable at each stage.
Scenarios are represented by structured tuples containing subjects and their appearance, scenes, events, compatible reactions, and camera movements. We compose tuples under semantic compatibility constraints—for example, the selected events must admit a visually observable response from the chosen subjects—and render them into a single-take generation script with five beats: initial scenario with the main subject → \rightarrow move the camera view away → \rightarrow show event → \rightarrow move the camera view back → \rightarrow revisit and reveal the resulting state and response. The full scripts are written by a VLM (Gemini3.1-Pro ( Team and DeepMind, 2026 ) ). Videos are then generated by the video foundation models ( Seedance et al., 2026 ; Team, 2026 ) based on the designed script.
(2) Verification and annotation. Generated videos do not necessarily obey their scripts, so we verify visual evidence after generation. Specifically, we use Gemini3.1-Pro ( Team and DeepMind, 2026 ) to check that each clip is a continuous shot, the designated subject remains visually consistent, the subject leaves and reappears, the event occurs in the intended view, the causal reaction is visible, and no severe hallucination invalidates the example. We further estimate global camera motion from Lucas–Kanade feature tracks using a RANSAC-based affine fit ( Fischler and Bolles, 1981 ) .
To ensure the camera motion correctness, we reject full-circle camera motions, missing returns, single-direction motion, and unreliable direction estimates.
For segment-wise supervision, we partition each video into multiple intervals and describe them jointly so that adjacent captions form a coherent progression. We audit these captions for future-event spoilers, references to an absent subject, malformed camera instructions, and excessive adjacent-caption overlap.

(1) Benchmark Construction . We construct EvoWorld-Bench as a 120-case evaluation set spanning photorealistic (69 cases) and game/virtual (51 cases) domains. Its initial frames have two complementary sources: 66 are extracted from held-out videos disjoint from the training set, while 54 are generated with GPT-Image-2 ( OpenAI, 2026 ) . Each case is organized into three semantic parts: an initial state, an event, and a revisit. After semantic deduplication, the benchmark covers 50+ fine-grained scene types and sub-event types, as summarized in Fig. 3 .
Moreover, we conduct dedicated similarity screening against all training videos. For every benchmark case, we retrieve potentially similar training samples using both frame visual similarity and the lexical and embedding-based semantic similarity of the initial-event prompt pair. We then inspect retrieved candidate pairs with a VLM-based two-pass audit and human adjudication of the ambiguous cases. We remove any candidate judged highly similar, leaving no source-clip overlap, initial-event prompt-pair overlap, or human-confirmed high-similarity pair in the final benchmark.
(2) Evaluation Metrics. We evaluate the complete rollout using Event Success, Revisit Success, Causal Plausibility, Reaction Quality, Visual Integrity, and revisit subject and background consistency.
Detailed inputs, scoring criteria, and aggregation rules are provided in Appendix Appendix A .

blocks.en: 3.3 Method
blocks.zh: 3.3 方法

blocks.en: 3.3.1 Overview

Most existing video world models provide little explicit support for interpreting what occurred during generation, maintaining a persistent account of entities outside the current view, or inferring how those entities should evolve before they reappear. We therefore introduce EvoWorld, a framework for Out-of-Sight Causal Evolution that explicitly separates world reasoning from visual rendering ( Fig. 4 ). A VLM brain observes every generated segment and records the realized entities, scene, and events. After an event occurs, it reasons over this history and predicts how the relevant world state, including the off-screen subject, should have evolved. A segment-autoregressive visual renderer then generates the next segment from the inferred instruction, retrieved entity evidence, and recent generated latents.
We equip the renderer with complementary entity and temporal anchors for long-range identity and short-range continuity. Identity-Anchored Attention (IAA) strengthens information flow from the entity anchor when the subject reappears. Our two-stage training first learns subject preservation and reactive rendering from clean ground-truth windows, and then performs online autoregressive rollout training from self-generated predecessor context. This Self-Forcing-style adaptation ( Huang et al., 2026 ) narrows the train-inference gap and refines model performance.
blocks.zh:
大多数现有的视频世界模型都很少为解释在一代人时期发生的事情提供明确支持,对当前观点以外的实体保持持续的陈述,或者推断这些实体在重新出现之前应如何演变。 因此,我们引入了"EvoWorld"(EvoWorld),这是一个"外视"(Out-Sight Causal Evolution)的框架,明确区分了世界推理和视觉渲染(图4). 一个VLM大脑观察每一个生成的片段,并记录已实现的实体,场景和事件. 事件发生后,它在这个历史中解释了原因,并预测了包括外屏主体在内的相关世界状态应如何演变. 然后从推断的指令、取回的实体证据和最近产生的潜伏物中生成下一段。
我们为渲染器配备了辅助实体和时间锚,用于远程识别和短程连续性. 身份-安克雷德关注(IAA)加强主体再现时来自实体锚地的信息流. 我们的两阶段培训首先从干净的地面实况窗口学习主题保存和反应性渲染,然后从自发的前身背景进行在线自发推出培训。 这种自强式改造(黄等,2026年)收缩了列车推导缺口并完善了模型性能.

blocks.en: 3.3.2 Entity and temporal anchors
blocks.zh: 3.3.2 实体和时间锚地

blocks.en:
The entity anchor carries subject appearance across a long out-of-view interval. During training, it is selected from ground-truth frames in which the target subject is clearly visible. At inference time, the VLM inspects sampled frames from the generated history, identifies a clear and unoccluded observation of the target subject, and retrieves the corresponding latents. This helps the renderer maintain subject identity and appearance when the camera revisits.
For temporal anchor, we adopt the four latents immediately preceding the target window, which participate in within-window full attention. This anchor is selected deterministically since recency is precisely the desired signal for view and motion continuity. Stage 1 takes these latents from the ground-truth videos, whereas stage 2 replaces them with the tail of the autoregressive rollout. At inference time they are always taken from the latest generated segment. The two anchors are therefore complementary: entity retrieval spans the long-term identity gap, while the temporal anchor bridges the local autoregressive boundary.
blocks.zh:
实体主播在很长的视线外间隔中呈现主题. 在培训期间,从目标对象清晰可见的地上真人框架中选定。 在推论时间,VLM检查从所生成历史中取样的帧,确定对目标对象的清晰而无隐蔽的观察,并取回相应的潜伏物. 这有助于渲染器在相机再现时保持主题身份和外观.
对于时间锚,我们采用目标窗口前的4个潜伏点,它们参与窗口内部的充分关注。 这个主锚是经过决定性选择的,因为恒定性恰恰是观测和运动连续性的理想信号. 第1阶段从地面真实视频中取出这些潜质,而第2阶段则取而代之的是自递式推出的尾部. 在推论中,它们总是取自最近产生的部分。 因此,这两个锚是互补的:实体检索跨越了长期的身份差距,而时间锚连接了当地的自递边界.

blocks.en: 3.3.5 VLM Brain: Perception and Reasoning
blocks.zh: 3.3.5 VLM 常规弹药 大脑:认知和理性

blocks.en: At inference time, our framework adopts a VLM as brain to perceive and reason over the world evolution continuously. After every completed segment, the renderer decodes sampled frames for the brain , which identifies and records the visible entities, appearances, object states, scenes, and any realized changes. These observations accumulate into a persistent world memory. Once an injected event has been rendered and observed, the brain records what actually occurred, retrieves the identity evidence, and reasons over the accumulated context to infer a causally plausible evolution of the relevant world state, including how the off-screen subject should respond. It then expresses the inferred state as a concrete generation prompt p ^ \hat{p} for the relevant subsequent segment. Additional details are provided in Appendix Appendix D .
blocks.zh: 在推论中,我们的框架采用VLM作为大脑来感知和理性对世界进化的持续. 在每一个完成的段后,渲染器会解码为大脑所采样的帧. . . 这些观察积累成一个持久的世界记忆. 一旦一个被注入的事件出现并被观察,大脑就会记录实际发生的情况,取回身份证据,以及累积上下文中推导相关世界状态因果上演的原因,包括非屏幕主体应如何应对. 然后表示推断的状态,作为随后相关段的混凝土一代即时p ^\ hat{p}。 更多详情见附录D。

blocks.en:
We compare EvoWorld with recent interactive video world models that support autoregressive generation: LingBot-World ( Team et al., 2026b ) , LingBot-World-v2 ( Gao et al., 2026 ) , YUME-1.5 ( Mao et al., 2026 ) , SANA-WM ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) , Echo-WM ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , and the standard and Turbo variants of Evoke ( Yin et al., 2026 ) . All baselines receive the same initial, event, and blind revisit prompts without a prescribed reaction, switched at matched semantic boundaries through their native autoregressive interfaces. Implementation details and additional general video models with one-shot results under a different, composed-prompt setting are provided in Appendix Appendix F .
We evaluate Out-of-Sight Causal Evolution on EvoWorld-Bench with the following metrics: Event Success , Revisit Success , Causal Plausibility , Reaction Quality , and Visual Integrity . We additionally assess subject and background consistency between the opening and revisited views while allowing causally appropriate changes in pose, state, and viewpoint, and report Motion Smoothness using VBench ( Huang et al., 2024 ) . Our primary task-level measure, Core Task Success , requires Event Success, Revisit Success, and full Causal Plausibility (i.e., causal plausibility score=1) to hold simultaneously. Appendix Appendix A provides the complete evaluation protocol.

blocks.zh: 4.3 视外原因演变的结果

blocks.en: Out-of-sight causal evolution. As shown in Table 1 , EvoWorld achieves 90.8% Core Task Success, exceeding the second-best baseline by 69.1 percentage points. Existing world models can often execute individual parts of the rollout: for example, Evoke-Turbo reaches 98.3% Revisit Success and 89.2% Event Success. However, its Core Task Success and Causal Plausibility results reveal that successful camera control and event rendering do not by themselves produce a coherent event–reaction chain. In contrast, EvoWorld obtains promising Revisit Success, Event Success, and Causal Plausibility. Its Causal Plausibility and Reaction Quality outperform other methods by a significant margin, demonstrating a substantially stronger ability to render causally plausible interaction evolution in the out-of-sight setting. Consistency and generation quality. The improvement in task success does not come at the cost of appearance preservation or visual quality. EvoWorld achieves promising Subject Consistency, Background Consistency, Visual Integrity, and Motion Smoothness. Its consistently high VLM-based scores and VBench ( Huang et al., 2024 ) motion evaluation indicate strong Out-of-Sight Causal Evolution performance while preserving generation quality.

blocks.en: In this section, we adopt a research-question-driven analysis to analyze and validate the effectiveness of our method, including ablation studies and other analyses.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 2 , IAA increases Core Task Success from 82.5% to 84.2% and Reaction Quality from 80.8% to 83.9%, demonstrating the benefit of strengthening attention to retrieved entity evidence. Stage 2 further raises Core Task Success to 90.8% and Causal Plausibility to 94.2%. These results indicate that both IAA and stage-2 online rollout training improve the model’s capability for out-of-sight causal evolution .
blocks.zh: 如表2所示,IAA将核心任务成功率从82.5%提高到84.2%,反应质量从80.8%提高到83.9%,这表明加强对所取取实体证据的关注是有益的。 第2阶段进一步将核心任务成功率提高到90.8%,将因果关系提高到94.2%。 这些结果表明,国际宇航科学院和第二阶段在线推出培训都提高了模型外视因果演进的能力。

blocks.en: We replace the brain-generated reasoning prompt with the blind revisit prompt while retaining the trained EvoWorld renderer and visual conditioning. As shown in Fig. 5 , performance drops substantially without event-conditioned reasoning, confirming its importance for inferring an appropriate response from the realized event. This variant nevertheless remains stronger than the baselines, indicating that the proposed data and renderer training already provide a strong event-conditioned causal-response prior. Moreover, applying the same reasoning prompts to Evoke-Turbo consistently improves its task metrics ( Table 3 ), demonstrating that the benefit transfers across visual renderers.

blocks.en: As an additional reference to the VLM-based Event Success metric, we compare the generated event segment with its event prompt using CLIP ViT-B/32 ( Radford et al., 2021 ) . We recover each model’s actual event-prompt interval, uniformly sample eight frames, and report their mean similarity (EPA-Abs) and the mean of the two highest similarities (EPA-TopK). As shown in Table 4 , EvoWorld obtains the highest scores. These results should be interpreted only as a relative comparison: event prompts contain substantial shared scene and camera descriptions, while CLIP similarity cannot precisely determine whether a fine-grained event action has been correctly executed.

blocks.en: We provide LingBot-World, Evoke, and EvoWorld with the same VLM-inferred revisit prompt to isolate renderer capability. As shown in Fig. 6 , the baselines exhibit hallucinated event entities, subject duplication, or coarse revisit frames, whereas EvoWorld preserves the subject and scene while rendering a coherent defensive response. Thus, an appropriate reasoning prompt must be paired with a renderer capable of preserving history and realizing the inferred evolution.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
In this paper,
we formulate Out-of-Sight Causal Evolution as a concrete setting for investigating autonomous world evolution and construct EvoWorld-Data/Bench to support learning and evaluating event realization, causally plausible post-event states, revisit consistency, and visual quality. We further present the EvoWorld framework, a reasoning-augmented brain-renderer collaboration framework that continuously perceives and renders the world dynamics. The renderer is trained with identity-anchored attention and a two-stage procedure that combines supervised learning of reactive rendering with autoregressive rollout training. Experiments show that EvoWorld substantially improves Out-of-Sight Causal Evolution capabilities over recent video world models while preserving generation quality and consistency.
We hope this study can provide a reference for future research in reasoning-enhanced world evolution. Limitations and future directions are discussed in Appendix Appendix G .

Camera direction is verified independently from sparse Lucas–Kanade feature tracks ( Lucas and Kanade, 1981 ) and a RANSAC affine fit ( Fischler and Bolles, 1981 ) ; clips with a missing reversal, full-circle motion, only unidirectional motion, or unreliable estimates are rejected. For each retained video, we record the subject-disappearance and reappearance times, camera phase boundaries, event interval, reaction interval, and generation provenance. Segment captions are produced jointly across adjacent intervals and audited to remove future-event spoilers, references to an absent subject, malformed camera commands, and redundant neighboring descriptions.
blocks.zh: 所生成的考生会被检查为连续射击结构,主体身份,完成主体退出和再入,可见事件实现,可见反应,并严重渲染失败. 相机方向由稀有的卢卡斯-克纳德特征轨迹(Lucas and Kanade,1981年)和一款RANSAC相接相机(Fischler and Bolles,1981年;相机方向由相机相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接 对于每个保留下来的视频,我们记录主题消失和再出现时间,相机相相接边界,事件间隔,反应间隔,以及生成出处. 片段字幕通过相邻间隔联合制作,并经过审计去除未来事件的破坏者,引用一个缺失的主体,错误的相机命令,以及冗余的相邻描述.

blocks.en: A.2 Reviewed semantic taxonomy
blocks.zh: A.2 审查的语义分类法

blocks.en: Raw generation labels contain aliases and style prefixes and therefore overestimate semantic diversity. We consolidate the EvoWorld-Data labels into a two-level taxonomy: a coarse family and a fine-grained semantic type. Synonyms are merged, and rendering styles such as AAA, voxel, fantasy, or photorealistic do not create a new type unless the underlying event, environment, or reaction is semantically distinct. For EvoWorld-Bench, we report only event and scene coverage: the benchmark does not define or expose target reaction categories, and any causally plausible response is accepted. Table 5 reports the resulting human-reviewed statistics.
blocks.zh: 原始生成标签包含别名和样式前缀,并因此高估了语义多样性. 我们把EvoWorld-Data的标签整合为一个两级分类法:粗糙的家族和精细的语义类型. 同义词被合并,而渲染风格如AAA,活泼,幻想,或相片现实主义等,除非基础事件,环境,或反应具有相形见绌的特点,否则不会创造出新的类型. 对"EvoWorld-Bench"来说,我们只报告事件和场景覆盖范围:基准没有定义或暴露目标反应类别,任何因果合理反应都被接受. 表5报告了由此产生的经人审查的统计数据。

blocks.en: Table 5: Reviewed semantic coverage of EvoWorld-Data and EvoWorld-Bench. Reaction categories are reported only for the training data; EvoWorld-Bench does not define target reactions.
blocks.zh: 表5:EvoWorld-Data和EvoWorld-Bench语义报道回顾. EvoWorld-Bench没有定义目标反应。

blocks.en: The event taxonomy includes, for example, fire and combustion, structural collapse, wild-animal intrusion, supernatural emergence, flooding, atmospheric disturbance, and vehicle failure. Reaction families in EvoWorld-Data include evasive relocation and active defense, among others.
blocks.zh: 例如,事件分类包括:火灾和燃烧、结构倒塌、野生动物入侵、超自然出现、洪水、大气扰动和车辆故障。 在"EvoWorld-Data"中的反应家庭包括躲避搬迁和主动防御等.

blocks.en: A.3 EvoWorld-Bench construction and train–test screening
blocks.zh: A.3. EvoWorld-Bench建筑和火车测试筛选

blocks.en: The 120 benchmark cases comprise 69 photorealistic and 51 game/virtual scenarios. Sixty-six initial frames come from held-out source videos and 54 are generated with GPT-Image-2 ( OpenAI, 2026 ) . We first remove exact source overlap and then screen every benchmark case against the complete training split at both the visual and semantic levels. Visual retrieval uses the benchmark initial frame to obtain its nearest training frames, while semantic retrieval operates on the paired initial and event prompts using lexical overlap and text-embedding similarity and requires both parts to come from the same training video. The union of these candidates is passed to a first VLM comparison. Pairs with substantial similarity in both the initial state and event are re-evaluated by a second multimodal pass that jointly receives the two initial frames and all four prompt fields. Ambiguous cases are manually adjudicated, and any benchmark candidate with a confirmed identical or near-identical training counterpart is removed or revised. A high first-frame similarity alone, or membership in the same scene or event category, is not treated as evidence of duplication.
blocks.zh: 120个基准案例包括69个照片真实性和51个游戏/虚拟情景。 66个初始相框来自被搁置的源视频,54个相框由GPT-Image-2(OpenAI,2026)所生成. 我们首先消除精确的源重迭,然后对每个基准案例进行筛选,对照在视觉和语义两个层面的完整的训练划分. 视觉检索使用基准初始框架来获取其最近的训练框架,而语义检索则在对接初始和事件提示上进行,使用词典重叠和文本嵌入的相似性,并要求两个部分来自同一训练视频. 这些候选人的结合通过第一次自愿参与活动比较。 在初始状态和事件上都相当相似的对等,由第二个多式联运通行证重新加以评价,该通行证共同接收两个初始框架和所有四个即时字段。 大量案件由人工裁决,任何基准候选人如经确认具有相同或接近相同培训的对应人员,均予以除名或修订。 单是高度的第一帧相似性,或属于同一场景或事件类别,不被视为重复的证据.

blocks.en: A.4 Prompt protocol and reaction-intensity calibration
blocks.zh: A.4 快速协议和反应强度校正

blocks.en:
We label every event by its required reaction intensity. A strong event requires an urgent response such as fleeing or taking cover, whereas a weak event permits either a mild or strong response.
This calibration prevents a visually present but implausibly weak response to a dangerous event from being counted as correct.
blocks.zh:
我们按每起事件的反应强度来标注 强烈事件需要紧急反应,例如逃离或掩护,而弱事件则允许温和或强烈的反应。
这种校正可以防止对危险事件的视觉现成但难以置信的微弱反应被算作正确.

blocks.en: At evaluation time, models receive the initial prompt, the event prompt at the appropriate switch point, and a blind revisit instruction that asks the subject to react without specifying how. The model must therefore infer an appropriate response from the event realized during its own rollout; the benchmark neither exposes nor requires a predefined reaction type, and any causally plausible response is considered valid. We audit all three prompts to ensure that the initial prompt does not reveal the event, the event prompt does not reveal the eventual response, and the blind revisit prompt contains neither a specific reaction nor future visual details.
blocks.zh: 在评价时,模型会收到初始的快取,事件在适当的切换点会被迅速取出,以及盲目重访指令,要求被试者做出反应而未具体说明如何反应. 因此,模型必须推断出在其自身推出过程中实现的事件的适当反应;该基准既不暴露也不要求预先确定的反应类型,任何因果合理的反应都被认为是有效的. 我们审计所有三个提示,以确保初始提示不显示事件,事件提示不显示最终的反应,盲目重访提示既没有包含具体的反应,也没有包含未来的视觉细节.

blocks.en: A.5 Evaluation protocol
blocks.zh: A.5 评价协议

blocks.en: Our evaluation combines complementary sources of evidence rather than relying on a single judge. A strong VLM Qwen3.8 ( Yang et al., 2025a ) assesses task execution, causal plausibility, visual integrity, and revisit consistency. Established tool-based metrics provide independent diagnostics: VBench ( Huang et al., 2024 ) measures motion smoothness, while CLIP ViT-B/32 ( Radford et al., 2021 ) supplies the auxiliary event–prompt alignment comparison in Table 4 .
blocks.zh: 我们的评价结合了补充证据来源,而不是依赖一名法官。 强VLM Qwen3.8(Yang等,2025a)评估任务执行,因果可信度,视觉完整性,并重新审视一致性. 基于工具的既定衡量标准提供独立的诊断: V Bench (Huang等,2024)测量运动平滑度,而CLIP VIT-B/32 (Radford等,2021)则提供辅助事件-表4中的即时比对.

blocks.en: For the VLM-based metrics, we temporally stratify each generated rollout into its beginning, middle, and ending portions and uniformly sample 30 frames across the three portions. The judge receives these frames, the initial and event prompts, and the strong/weak event-intensity label used to calibrate reaction strength, but not a target reaction or ground-truth revisit description. It jointly inspects whether the camera returns, whether the requested event is realized, what response the subject exhibits, whether that response is causally plausible at the required intensity, and whether the revisited subject and environment remain consistent. Event and revisit success are binary; the remaining perceptual and behavioral criteria use the three-level scale { 0 , 0.5 , 1 } \{0,0.5,1\} .
blocks.zh: 对于基于VLM的度量标准,我们按时间将每个生成的分解分解成其起始部分、中间部分和结尾部分,并统一抽取三部分的30个帧。 判断者接收到这些帧,初始和事件提示,以及用于校正反应强度的强/弱事件-强度标签,但不是一种目标反应或地-实重描述. 它联合检查摄像头是否返回、所请求的事件是否实现、主题显示的反应、反应在所需强度下是否因果合理以及重新审视的主题和环境是否始终一致。 事件和重温成功是二进制;其余的感知和行为标准采用三级尺度{0,0.5,1}},\{0,0.5,1}.

blocks.en: Event Success is 1 only if the event described by the event prompt visibly occurs in the middle portion of the generated rollout; otherwise it is 0. Revisit Success is 1 only if the camera first leaves the original subject and region and subsequently returns to the same location with the subject visible again. A reaction may cause the subject to leave the frame after being revisited without invalidating the revisit. A cut to an unrelated scene, or a return without the original subject, receives 0.
blocks.zh: 事件成功是1,只有当事件所描述的事件在生成的推出的中间部分明显发生;否则为0。 只有在相机先离开原主体与区域后,再返回同一位置,且主体再次可见的情况下,Revisit成功才为 1. 反应可能导致主体在重新审视后离开框架,而不会使重新审视无效. 切入不相干场景,或回回无原主体,则得到0.

blocks.en: This metric evaluates whether the subject’s changed behavior or state is a plausible consequence of the event that was actually rendered. The judge may use changes relative to stable landmarks—for example, retreating behind a doorway, moving behind cover, or relocating to higher ground—as evidence of an off-screen response. A score of 0 indicates no reaction when one is required, or a response that contradicts the event’s causal logic; 0.5 indicates a plausibly related but insufficiently strong response to a strong event; and 1 indicates a causally appropriate response at the expected intensity. We do not require one prescribed action: escape, cover, safe relocation, or defensive readiness may all receive full credit when appropriate. If either Event Success or Revisit Success is 0, Causal Plausibility is set to 0 because the generated video provides no valid event–reaction chain to assess.
blocks.zh: 这一衡量标准评估对象改变的行为或状态是否是实际发生事件的合理后果。 法官可以使用相对于稳定地标的改变——例如退到出入口后,走入掩蔽后,或转移到高地——作为屏幕外反应的证据。 得分为0表示在需要时没有反应,或者反应与事件因果逻辑相矛盾;0.5表示对强烈事件的合理关联但不够强烈的反应;1表示在预期强度下因果适宜的反应. 我们不需要一种规定的行动:逃跑、掩护、安全搬迁或防御准备都可能酌情获得充分的承认。 如果事件成功或重访成功均为 0, 则因生成的视频没有提供有效的事件- 反应链来评估而被设定为 0 。

blocks.en: Reaction Quality isolates the visual realization of the response from its semantic appropriateness. It receives 0 for broken, distorted, or incoherent reaction motion; 0.5 for a visible but stiff or mildly artifacted response; and 1 for a natural and coherent action or changed state. If no changed reaction state is visible, the per-case value is null and is treated as 0 in the all-case mean reported for cross-model comparison. Visual Integrity evaluates the complete rollout independently of task correctness: 0 denotes severe structural breakdown, hallucination, or melting; 0.5 denotes a watchable video with visible local artifacts, instability, or flicker; and 1 denotes a clean and coherent rollout without obvious breakdown, with particular attention paid to prompt-switch boundaries.
blocks.zh: 反应质量将反应的视觉实现与其语义上的适宜性相隔离. 它在断裂、扭曲或不连贯的反应运动中接收到0;在明显而僵硬或轻微的人工反应中接收到0.5;在自然和连贯的行动或改变状态时接收到1。 如果没有改变反应状态可见,则每例值为无效,在报告用于交叉模型比较的全例平均值中作为0处理. Visual Inception评价完全推出与任务正确性无关:0表示严重的结构崩溃、幻觉或融化;0.5表示可观看的视频,带有明显的局部文物、不稳定性或闪烁;1表示清晰而连贯的推出,没有明显的分解,特别注意即时开关。

blocks.en: Subject Consistency compares the opening subject with the revisited subject while explicitly allowing its pose, behavior, and state to change. A score of 0 denotes a different or severely drifted identity, 0.5 a recognizable subject with noticeable identity or appearance inconsistencies, and 1 a clearly preserved identity. If the subject does not reappear and therefore cannot be compared, the case receives a score of 0. The reported Subject Consistency is averaged over all 120 benchmark cases. Background Consistency compares the opening and revisited locations while allowing modest viewpoint changes: 0 indicates a different scene, 0.5 the same general place with a major object or layout inconsistency, and 1 the same location with its principal structures and objects preserved. Minor viewpoint changes or incidental small-object differences do not reduce the score.
blocks.zh: 主题一致性将开篇主题与再审主题进行比较,同时明确允许其外形,行为,状态发生变化. 0分表示不同或严重漂移的身份,0.5分表示明显身份或外表不一致的可识别主体,1分表示明确保存的身份. 如果主体没有再出现,因此无法相提并论,则案件得分为0分. 所有120个基准案例均报告主题一致性。 背景一致性比较开口和重审位置,同时允许微小的视角变化:0表示不同的场景;0.5表示相同的一般地段,主要物体或布局不一致;1表示相同的地段,保留其主要结构和物体. 小视角变化或偶然的小对象差异不会降低分数.

blocks.en: We report the Motion Smoothness dimension of VBench ( Huang et al., 2024 ) over all 120 generated videos. This metric is independent of the VLM judge and measures local temporal smoothness rather than completion of the event–revisit–reaction chain. Because it is highly saturated for modern video generators, we treat it as a secondary quality diagnostic rather than a primary task metric.
blocks.zh: 我们报导V Bench(黄等,2024年)的动作平滑度, 这个衡量标准独立于VLM法官,衡量的是局部时间平滑度,而不是事件-回顾-反应链的完成. 由于它对于现代的视频发电机来说是高度饱和的,所以我们把它作为二级质量诊断,而不是主要的任务衡量标准.

blocks.en: Both training stages optimize the renderer in a video-to-video (V2V) setting, using the first two temporal latent steps of the training clip as the entity reference. For benchmark evaluation, we use the same learned renderer directly in image-to-video (I2V) mode: the provided initial frame is encoded into one entity-reference latent step, after which generation proceeds autoregressively. Each later segment is conditioned on the final four latent steps of its generated predecessor. We also experimented with training the renderer directly in I2V mode and observed comparable benchmark performance; we therefore retain the unified V2V training configuration for the reported model.
blocks.zh: 这两个培训阶段在视频到视频(V2V)的设定中优化了渲染器,将培训片段的前两个潜在时间步骤作为实体参考。 对于基准评价,我们直接在图像到视频(I2V)模式下使用相同的已学习到的渲染器:所提供的初始帧被编码成一个实体参考潜在步骤,然后生成会自动进行. 以后的每一个部分都取决于其产生的前身的最后四个潜在步骤。 我们还试验了直接用I2V模式培训渲染器,并观察到可比的基准性能;因此,我们保留了所报告的模型的统一V2V培训配置.

blocks.en: Appendix C Two-stage training procedure
blocks.zh: 附录C 两级培训程序

blocks.en: Stage 2 uses a one-hop rollout rather than regenerating the entire history chain: it exposes the renderer to direct predecessor errors while keeping training tractable. Because the predecessor is regenerated by the current model as training progresses, the conditioning distribution co-evolves with the renderer rather than remaining fixed to a single offline snapshot. To prevent this focused adaptation from overwriting the initial, event, and clean-revisit behavior learned in Stage 1, we mix 25% deterministic samples with ground-truth temporal anchors drawn across all phases and 75% samples with online self-generated temporal anchors. At deployment, the resulting Stage-2 LoRA is used together with the same official distilled LoRA and eight-step sampler employed during online rollout.
blocks.zh: 第2阶段使用一跃式推出,而不是重生整个历史链:它让渲染器在保持可操作性的同时会直接出前身出错. 由于前身由目前的模型随着训练的进行而再生出,因此调节分配与渲染器共同演化,而不是固定在单一的离线快照上. 为了防止这种有重点的适应行为覆盖第一阶段所学到的初始、事件和清洁复审行为,我们把25%的确定性标本与覆盖各个阶段的地上真实时间标和75%的标本与在线自我生成的时间标本混合在一起。 在部署时,与在线推出期间使用的同一正式蒸馏LORA和八步取样器一起使用所产生的Stage-2 LORA。

blocks.en: Appendix D VLM brain protocol
blocks.zh: 附录D VLM 大脑协议

blocks.en: The VLM brain is called after every generated segment rather than only at the final revisit. Each call receives temporally sampled frames from the newly generated segment together with the accumulated textual world record. Its first responsibility is observational: it records visible entities and their attributes, persistent scene landmarks, object states, camera movement, and any newly realized event. Before an event has been observed, the brain updates this record but does not propose a reaction. This separation prevents the initial observation from leaking future event or reaction information.
blocks.zh: VLM脑在每一个生成的片段后被叫来,而不只是在最后的重访时被叫来. 每一次呼叫都从新生成的部分以及累积的文字世界记录中获得时间样本框架。 它的第一责任是观察:它记录可见的实体及其属性,持续的场景地标,物体状态,相机移动,以及任何新实现的事件. 在一个事件被观察到之前,大脑更新了这个记录,但没有提出反应. 这种分离使得初始观测无法泄露出未来的事件或反应信息.

blocks.en: After the event segment, the brain reasons from the event that was actually rendered, not merely from the requested event prompt. It identifies the affected off-screen subject, infers one causally plausible changed state or behavior, and converts that inference into a concrete renderer prompt. The prompt specifies the camera return, preserved identity cues, the subject’s post-event state, and visually realizable behavior, while avoiding hidden mental states or explanations that cannot be rendered. The benchmark remains open-ended: this inferred behavior need not match an exact reaction if it is causally plausible for the realized event.
blocks.zh: 在事件段之后,大脑的原因 由事件 实际提供, 不只是从请求的事件 提示。 它识别了受影响的外屏对象,推断出一种因果上可信的改变状态或行为,并将这种推论转换为混凝土渲染器的提示. 提示指定了相机返回,保存的身份提示,对象的后事件状态,以及可视化的行为,同时避免隐藏的精神状态或无法表达的解释. 该基准仍然没有限制:如果对已实现的事件具有因果关系,这种推断的行为就不需要与确切的反应相匹配。

blocks.en: For long-range identity conditioning, the framework can select a clear prior observation of the target entity and map it to the corresponding latent span. In the reported controlled I2V evaluation, the opening frame is deliberately constructed to show the target clearly and is used as the persistent one-step entity reference. Content-based retrieval is retained for longer or less constrained rollouts in which the clearest observation need not be the first frame. In either case, retrieval determines visual evidence, whereas the VLM-generated prompt determines the subsequent semantic state; the four most recent generated latent steps provide short-range temporal continuity independently of this decision.
blocks.zh: 对于远程身份条件,框架可以选择目标实体的清晰的前期观测,并绘制到相应的潜在跨度. 在所报告的受控I2V评价中,开口框架被刻意地构建,以清晰地显示目标,并被作为持久的单步实体参考. 基于内容的检索被保留用于较长或更少的限制推出,其中最明确的观察不必是第一个框架。 无论是哪种情况,检索都决定视觉证据,而VLM生成的即时决定了随后的语义状态;最近产生的四个潜在步骤提供了独立于这一决定的短程时间连续性.

blocks.en: Fig. 7 summarizes one reference brain-renderer interaction. The brain first records the knight’s identity, equipment, and cathedral environment before the camera moves away. It then observes the event actually realized by the renderer: although the requested gargoyle was intended to remain near the gate, the generated creature begins advancing into the nave. Based on this observed threat and the accumulated subject memory, the brain produces a revisit prompt in which the knight has raised the same shield and adopted a braced defensive stance. The final observation verifies that the rendered response is causally appropriate while preserving the subject, equipment, and scene. This example illustrates how the brain conditions its reasoning on the realized visual history rather than relying only on the requested event prompt.
blocks.zh: 图7总结了1个参考的脑-手互动. 大脑首先记录了骑士的身份,设备,以及相机移动之前的教堂环境. 然后,它观察了造出者实际实现的事件:虽然要求的gargoyle是打算留在大门附近,但所生成的生物开始向下进发. 基于所观测到的威胁和所积累的主题记忆,大脑产生回想快活,骑士在回想快活时也举起同样的盾牌并采取了站稳了的防御姿态. 最后的观察证实,在保留主体、设备和场景的同时,所作的反应在因果关系上是适当的。 这个例子说明大脑是如何将其推理条件建立在已实现的视觉历史上,而不是仅仅依赖所请求的事件即时.

blocks.en: Entity-reference and target-window tokens are combined through the native LTX conditioning path. Here, the target window denotes the complete generation-side latent sequence, including the clean temporal anchor and the target latents being denoised. Their physical order differs across code paths: training forms [ entity reference ∣ target window ] [\text{entity reference}\mid\text{target window}] , whereas inference appends the reference and forms [ target window ∣ entity reference ] [\text{target window}\mid\text{entity reference}] . IAA therefore derives the entity-key range from the actual reference length and layout instead of assuming a fixed prefix position. Runtime checks verify the reference length, the contiguous denoised-query span, and the target–reference boundary.

blocks.en: Appendix F Baseline reproduction details
blocks.zh: 附录F 基线复制详情

blocks.en: For every benchmark case, all autoregressive models receive the same three user-facing conditions: (i) an initial prompt describing the starting subject and scene, (ii) an event prompt introduced only after the camera has moved away, and (iii) a blind revisit prompt that asks the camera to return and the subject to react without revealing a particular reaction. The corresponding camera schedule moves the view away from the subject, exposes the event region, and then moves the view back. We inject each prompt at the nearest native chunk boundary and preserve the model’s recurrent state, latent history, or memory cache across switches. Thus, no model is reset at the event or revisit boundary. In the main comparison, baselines directly execute the blind revisit prompt and receive neither VLM-generated reaction reasoning nor entity retrieval; EvoWorld internally interprets the same blind request using its VLM brain. For a more detailed ablation, the prompt-transfer and shared-prompt analyses in Tables 3 and 6 also provide baseline renderers with the brain-generated reasoning prompt, allowing us to separate the contribution of event-conditioned reasoning from that of the proposed data and renderer training.
blocks.zh: 对于每个基准例,所有自转模型都得到相同的三个用户化条件:(一)一个初始的即时描述起动主体和场景,(二)一个事件仅在相机移动后才被引入,(三)一个盲目的再审视即时要求相机返回,被主体在不透露特定反应的情况下作出反应. 相机对应的相机时间表将取景移出主体,曝光出事件区域,再将取景移回. 我们向最近的本地块边界注入每个提示,并保存模型的反复状态、潜在历史或内存缓存。 因此,在事件或重新审视边界时,没有重设模型。 在主比较中,基线直接执行盲重访即时,既不接收VLM生成的反应推理,也不接收实体回取; EvoWorld内部使用它的VLM大脑解释相同的盲取请求. 关于更详细的解释,表3和表6中的即时转移和共享即时分析也为基线渲染器提供了脑所生成的推理即时反应,使我们能够将事件有条件推理的贡献与拟议数据和渲染器培训的贡献区分开来。

blocks.en: We also conducted preliminary protocol-compatibility trials with HY-World 1.5 ( HunyuanWorld, 2025 ) , Matrix-Game 3.0 ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , and AlayaWorld ( Team et al., 2026a ) , but do not include them in the quantitative comparison because their released models did not reliably support the complete evaluation protocol. In particular, HY-World 1.5 frequently continued the preceding content while weakly realizing or entirely ignoring the event introduced by the mid-rollout prompt switch. Matrix-Game 3.0 and AlayaWorld likewise did not consistently complete the combined move-away, newly injected event, blind revisit, and event-conditioned reaction sequence under their available inference interfaces. This mismatch is unsurprising: these systems are trained primarily for their respective action-conditioned interaction, spatial persistence, or general world-generation objectives, rather than on data that explicitly couples mid-rollout event injection with off-screen subject evolution. Their behavior in our setting should therefore not be interpreted as a general assessment of their visual quality or intended capabilities. We leave systematic adaptation and controlled comparison of these models to future work.
blocks.zh: 我们还与HY-World 1.5(HunyuanWorld,2025年),Matrix-Game 3.0(Wang等,2026年)和AlayaWorld(Team等,2026年a)进行了初步协议相容性试验,但由于它们发布的模型不能可靠地支持完整的评估协议,因此没有将其纳入定量比较. 特别是,HY-World 1.5经常继续沿用前述内容,同时弱化或完全忽略了由中间推出的即时切换引入的事件. Matrix-Game 3.0和AlayaWorld同样没有在其现有的推论界面下,连贯地完成移动出,新注射出的事件,盲目重访,以及事件有条件的反应序列. 这种不匹配是不足为奇的:这些系统的培训主要是针对它们各自的行动条件互动、空间持久性或世界一代的一般目标,而不是针对明确与屏幕外的主体演化相配的数据。 因此,他们的行为不应被解释为对其视觉质量或预期能力的一般评估。 我们将这些模型的系统调整和控制性比较留给今后的工作。

blocks.en: For LingBot-World v1 ( Team et al., 2026b ) and v2 ( Gao et al., 2026 ) , we use the official interactive interfaces, translate the benchmark trajectory into their native camera controls, and schedule all prompts within one persistent rollout. We evaluate the released YUME-1.5 5B checkpoint ( Mao et al., 2026 ) at 720p through its long-context autoregressive interface. For SANA-WM ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) , we use the released streaming checkpoint and assign the three prompts to a 3 / 2 / 3 3/2/3 schedule over its eight autoregressive blocks, with camera motion supplied through its native trajectory interface. Echo-WM ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) is evaluated with sequential prompt switching while retaining its persistent autoregressive world state. Evoke and Evoke-Turbo ( Yin et al., 2026 ) use the official image-to-video segment mode with matched inputs and prompt boundaries, differing only in their released variants and native sampling configurations.
blocks.zh: 对于"LingBot-World v1"(Team等,2026b)和"v2(Gao等,2026)",我们使用官方交互界面,将基准轨迹翻译为他们的原生相机控制,并将所有提示都排在一次持续推出内. 我们通过长文本自递式接口,在720p评估释放的YUME-1.5 5B检查站(Mao等,2026年)。 对于SANA-WM(Zhu等,2026年),我们使用已放出流出检查站,并指定三个提示器在其八个自旋区块上以3 / 2. / 3 / 3/2/ 3 / 时刻表,由相机运动通过其原生轨道接口提供. Echo-WM(Zhang等,2026b.)通过相继即时切换来评价,同时保留其持续的自回世界状态. Evoke和Evoke-Turbo(Yin等,2026年)使用官方的图像到视频段模式,并配有相匹配的输入和即时的边界,仅在其释放的变种和本土采样配置上有所不同.

blocks.en: We additionally evaluate Wan2.2 TI2V-5B ( Wan et al., 2025 ) , LTX-2.3, and LTX-2.5 ( HaCohen et al., 2026 ) as general one-shot video generators. Each model receives a single composed prompt containing the initial, event, and blind revisit instructions and generates the complete video in one pass. These models therefore observe the intended event and camera-return instruction before generation begins, unlike the main autoregressive setting in which the event is introduced only during rollout. We report their results in Table 7 for completeness but do not include them in the main comparison.
blocks.zh: 我们还评价了Wan2.2 TI2V-5B(Wan等人,2025年),LTX-2.3和LTX-2.5(HaCohen等人,2026年)作为一般一发相机。 每个模型都收到一个包含初始、事件和盲目重温指令的由单一组成的提示,并生成完整的视频。 因此,这些模型在开始生成前就观察了预定的事件和相机回放指令,与仅在推出时才引入事件的主要自旋设置不同. 我们在表7中报告结果是否完整,但未列入主要比较。

blocks.en: Appendix G Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 附录G 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: Although the segment-autoregressive design does not impose a fixed semantic horizon and can autoregressively extend the rollout, the present work focuses on a single event followed by a single subject reaction. This controlled scope isolates the minimal out-of-sight event–reaction chain, but does not yet capture long-horizon worlds in which multiple events interact, earlier reactions alter later conditions, or several entities respond over time. Extending the data, reasoning memory, training procedure, and evaluation protocol to multi-event and multi-reaction evolution is therefore an important direction for future work. In addition, our current scenarios primarily employ horizontal move-away and move-back camera trajectories because they represent the most common and directly interpretable camera motion for revisit scenarios. We do not systematically evaluate more complex camera motion, such as large vertical displacement, depth-wise movement, orbiting, or compound six-degree-of-freedom trajectories, which may make scene correspondence, entity retrieval, and revisit consistency substantially more difficult. Future versions of EvoWorld-Data and EvoWorld-Bench should incorporate these trajectories and evaluate whether the framework remains robust under more general interactive camera control.
blocks.zh: 虽然片段自发设计并不强制固定语义地平线,并且可以自发地延伸推出,但目前的工作侧重于单个事件,然后是单个主题反应. 这种可控的范围孤立了最小的外视事件—反应链,但还没有捕捉出多个事件相互作用,更早的反应会改变后期条件,或几个实体随时间推移做出响应的长视世界. 因此,将数据、推理记忆、培训程序和评价协议扩大到多事件和多反应演化,是今后工作的一个重要方向。 此外,我们目前的情景主要采用横向移动和回移相机轨迹,因为这些相机是用于重温情景的最常见和最直接可解释的相机运动. 我们并不系统地评估更复杂的相机运动,例如大型垂直移动、深度移动、轨道运行或六度自由轨距复合,这可能使现场通信、实体检索和重温一致性更加困难。 未来版本的"EvoWorld-Data"和"EvoWorld-Bench"应该纳入这些轨迹,并评价框架在更普遍的交互式相机控制下是否依然坚固.
